purpose: Measure all original workloads with identical worker processor classes after observed cross-class latency shifts in unchanged controls.
source_policy: Unmodified pinned published wheel, exact frozen Phase 13 source and current candidate; experiment manifests record their hashes before execution.

primary_full_run.processor_class: Windows EfficiencyClass 1, observed logical processors 0 through 15

placement_policy: Set only the worker process affinity before CoolProp, NumPy, Equinox or JAX imports; all threads inherit the same allowed processors. Verify readback before and after execution. The controller and unrelated processes are unchanged. No machine power policy is changed.
unrestricted_comparison: Retain the immutable original four-worker nine-sample full matrix, the later four-worker cold measurements and observed within-worker processor-class associations. A second unrestricted full repeat is not mandatory: it repeats the uncontrolled scheduler condition without isolating a new cause. Only run an optional two-worker 12-sample unrestricted diagnostic when the controlled result leaves a specific unanswered question; declare that question and selection first. Omission of --cpu-affinity observes and preserves inherited scheduling. No historical sample is invalidated solely for processor placement.

optional_class_diagnostic.purpose: Quantify the observed placement association across identically constrained sources, separately from the full gate.
optional_class_diagnostic.interpretation: Diagnostic only; a filtered timing selection still runs registered validators and does not reproduce the full predecessor mix. Placement can change JAX thread scheduling; it is not a package optimization. No class-normalized acceptance ratios.

order_and_inputs: Use the unchanged runner's declared version blocks and forward/reverse case blocks. Twelve samples balance both block directions and three numerical variants. Do not reset providers between thermodynamic calls or remove fluid-switching costs.
correctness: Retain original independent checks and complete candidate/frozen fields, metadata, status, clipping, dtype and shapes, plus published common-field comparison. Keep every workload and original numerical tolerance.
acceptance: Use the original phase13/acceptance.json category budgets without changing thresholds. Keep every timing sample, including GC, migrations and spikes. No ratios corrected by controls or processor class. Report any remaining budget failures explicitly.
gc_and_snapshots: Use original normal GC and in-memory verification snapshots. The matched snapshot-release diagnostic showed no benefit and does not authorize a harness performance fix.
harness_policy: Record the revised harness hash for every worker. Preserve the exact pre-affinity archive and old results; changing the harness during a running experiment is invalid.
